import json, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=None;L=None
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(r))==1 and next(iter(set(r)))!=bg:
            line=i; L=next(iter(set(r)))
    cells=[(i,j,c) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,c in enumerate(r) if c!=bg and c!=L]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,j,c in cells:
        out[i][j]=bg
    minr=min(c[0] for c in cells); maxr=max(c[0] for c in cells)
    h=maxr-minr+1
    delta=(line+1)-minr
    for i,j,c in cells:
        i+=delta
        out[i][j]=c
    out[line+h+1]=[8]*W
    return out

from collections import Counter
def analyze(g,name):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    lines=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and next(iter(set(r)))!=bg and sum(c==g[i][0] for c in r)==W]

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    cand=list(cnt.most_common(3))
    def full(n):
        return any(all(g[i][j]==n for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)) or any(all(g[i][j]==n for i in range(H)) for j in range(W))
    linecol=next(c for c,_ in cand if full(c))
    axis='row' if any(all(g[i][j]==linecol for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)) else 'col'
    p=next(i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==linecol for j in range(W))) if axis=='row' else next(j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==linecol for i in range(H)))
    bgn=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bgn and g[i][j]!=linecol]
    out=[[bgn]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='row':
        rs=sorted({i for i,_,_ in cells}); lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
        delta=(p+1-lo) if lo>p else (p-1-hi)
        cc=[(i+delta,j,g[i][j]) for i,j,v in cells]
        mn,mx=min(a for a,b,_ in cc),max(a for a,b,_ in cc)
        pos=int(round(2*(mn+mx)/2-p))   # mirror of line across object center
        for i,j,v in cc: out[i][j]=v
        for j in range(W): out[pos][j]=8
    else:
        cs=sorted({j for _,j,_ in cells}); lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
        delta=(p+1-lo) if lo>p else (p-1-hi)
        cc=[(i,j+delta,g[i][j]) for i,j,v in cells]
        mn,mx=min(b for _,b,_ in cc),max(b for _,b,_ in cc)
        pos=int(round(2*(mn+mx)/2-p))
        for i,j,v in cc: out[i][j]=v
        for i in range(H): out[i][pos]=8
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgn=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    linecol=None;axis=None
    for c in list(cnt):
        if c==bgn: continue
        if any(all(g[i][j]==c for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)): linecol,axis=c,'row'; break
        elif any(all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(H)) for j in range(W)): linecol,axis=c,'col'; break
    p=(next(i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==linecol for j in range(W))) if axis=='row' 
       else next(j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==linecol for i in range(H))))
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (bgn,linecol)]
    out=[[bgn]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='row':
        rs=sorted({i for i,_,_ in cells}); mn,mx=min(rs),max(rs)
        if mn<p: # above -> down
            delta=max(0,p-1-mx)
            cc=[(i+delta,j,v) for i,j,v in cells]
            pos=max(i for i,_,_ in cc)-1      # 8 just above far edge
        else:    # below -> up
            delta=max(0,p+1-mn)
            cc=[(i+delta,j,v) for i,j,v in cells]
            pos=max(i for i,_,_ in cc)+1
        for i,j,v in cc: out[i][j]=v
        for j in range(W): out[pos][j]=8
    else:
        cs=sorted({j for _,j,_ in cells}); mn,mx=min(cs),max(cs)
        if mn<p:
            delta=max(0,p-1-mx); cc=[(i,j+delta,v) for i,j,v in cells]
            pos=max(j for _,j,_ in cc)-1
        else:
            delta=max(0,p+1-mn); cc=[(i,j+delta,v) for i,j,v in cells]
            pos=max(j for _,j,_ in cc)+1
        for i,j,v in cc: out[i][j]=v
        for i in range(H): out[i][pos]=8
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgn=None; linecol=None; axis=None; p=None
    # find line color first (full row/col), background = most common non-line color
    cand=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common() if c!=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)]
    for c,_ in cnt.most_common():
        if c==bgn: continue
        if any(all(g[i][j]==c for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)):
            linecol,axis,p=c,'row',next(i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==c for j in range(W)))
            break
        if any(all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(H)) for j in range(W)):
            linecol,axis,p=c,'col',next(j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(H)))
            break
    bgn=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bgn and g[i][j]!=linecol]
    out=[[bgn]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='row':
        mn=min(i for i,_,_ in cells); mx=max(i for i,_,_ in cells)
        if mn>p:                      # below line: top becomes p+1, far=bottom, dir=+1
            delta=p+1-mn; far=mx+delta; dir=1
        else:                         # above line: bottom becomes p-1, far=top, dir=-1
            delta=p-1-mx; far=mn+delta; dir=-1
        for i,j,v in cells: out[i+delta][j]=v
        for j in range(W): out[far+dir][j]=8
    else:
        mn=min(j for _,j,_ in cells); mx=max(j for _,j,_ in cells)
        if mn<p:                      # left of line: right becomes p-1, far=left, dir=-1
            delta=p-1-mx; far=mn+delta; dir=-1
        else:                         # right of line: left becomes p+1, far=right, dir=+1
            delta=p+1-mn; far=mx+delta; dir=1
        for i,j,v in cells: out[i][j+delta]=v
        for i in range(H): out[i][far+dir]=8
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

from collections import Counter
import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color: most common non-bg color forming a complete full row or col
    cand=None; best=(-1,None,None)
    for c,n in cnt.items():
        if c==bgc: continue
        rows=[i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==c for j in range(W))]
        cols=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(H))]
        if rows:
            key=(1,c,rows[0])
        elif cols:
            key=(0,c,cols[0])
        else:
            continue
        if best[0]<key[0] or (best[0]==key[0] and best[1]<c):
            best=key
    axis,p,c=best
    linecol=c
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bgc and g[i][j]!=linecol]
    out=[[bgc]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='row':
        mn=min(i for i,_,_ in cells); mx=max(i for i,_,_ in cells)
        if mn>p:                       # below line: near=top(mn), far=bottom(mx), away +1
            near,far=mn,mx; delta=(p+1)-near; pos=far+1
        else:                          # above line: near=bottom(mx), far=top(mn), away -1
            near,far=mx,mn; delta=(p-1)-near; pos=far-1
        for i,j,v in cells: out[i+delta][j]=v
        for j in range(W):
            if p!=pos or True: out[p][j]=linecol
        for j in range(W):
            if out[p][j]!=linecol: out[pos][j]=8
    else:
        mn=min(j for _,j,_ in cells); mx=max(j for _,j,_ in cells)
